recentItems.title: Chandra Sekhar Superintendent of Jail Exclusive Interview | Crime Diaries With Muralidhar | iDream
recentItems.description:
#VizagJail, #CentralJail, #PrisonLife, #CrimeDiaries, #Reformation, #TeluguInterviews, #JailSuperintendent, #IndianPrisons, #TrendingPodcast, #AndhraPradesh,
Chandra Sekhar Superintendent of Jail Exclusive Interview | Crime Diaries With Muralidhar | iDream 

A Unique Prison Experience: Host and Superintendent of Visakhapatnam Central Jail, Chandrasekhar, take viewers on an exclusive tour of one of Andhra Pradesh's most scenic and green prisons.

From Deterrence to Reformation: Learn how modern prisons have shifted from the brutal British-era "punishment theory" to a correctional "washing machine" philosophy focused on reforming inmates.

Handling Trouble & The "Blade Batch": Superintendent Chandrasekhar candidly discusses how prison authorities manage difficult inmates, tackle self-harm tactics, and prevent gang formations.

Inmate Activities & Skills: Discover the various vocational training units inside the jail—ranging from steel furniture making and bakeries to weaving and agricultural work—designed to give prisoners a fresh start.

Debunking Myths: The interview clears up common misconceptions about inside privileges, cash payments for comfort rooms, and the rigorous daily routines of prison officials.

recentItems.title: The Untold Reality of Indian Army: Ft. Major Harshavardhan Chava |Soldiers' Sacrifices & Border Life
recentItems.description:
#MajorHarshaVardhanChava, #IndianArmy, #ArmyLife, #MilitarySecrets, #SSBInterview, #DefenceAspirants, #TeluguPodcast, #ArmedForces, #NationFirst, #IndianMilitary,
The Untold Reality of Indian Army: Ft. Major Harshavardhan Chava |Soldiers' Sacrifices & Border Life

A Salute to Our Protectors: In this deeply engaging podcast, anchor Lasya Reddy sits down with Major Harsha Vardhan Chava to uncover the raw, unfiltered truth behind the lives of Indian Army officers and soldiers.

Army vs. Civil Life: Major Harsha shares his personal transition from the ultra-disciplined military ecosystem back to civilian life, highlighting the stark cultural contrasts.

Zero Personal Freedom: Discover how personal life takes a back seat, why permissions are mandatory even for a simple family outing, and the strict protocols governing international travel.

The Unforgiving Training & Rules: Learn why saying "No" does not exist in the army, the extreme realities of handling minefields, and the rigorous psychological and physical standards of the SSB interview.

Facing Fear and the Oath: Get a firsthand account of how soldiers conquer fear, live by the motto "Hope for the best, prepare for the worst," and honor their ultimate oath to the nation.
